meta_gate.impact_analysis: No result was ever produced under v1, so no verdict changes and the replay is empty.
meta_gate.independent_review: PENDING. The same agent wrote v1 and this draft, so this review is not independent; a human or separate reviewer must sign.
meta_gate.on_approval: Add decision D-127, freeze this file with a pinned SHA-256 like v1, keep v1 untouched.

amendment_rule: Once FROZEN this file is never edited. A change is a new file evaluation_protocol_v3.json approved through the D-100 meta-gate.

origin_policy.default: End of a calendar month; only information with a publication time on or before the origin may be used.
origin_policy.spf_alignment: Comparisons with the SPF re-run every model at the survey deadline date published in the SPF documentation, using only data published by then. Month-end origins are never compared with SPF forecasts.

comparison_unit: The object under test is a forecasting method (model, estimation window and procedure), not the truth of a model.

forecast_product.distribution: A precise predictive distribution given as quantiles 5% to 95% in 5% steps, so that proper scoring rules apply.
forecast_product.imprecise_probabilities: Allowed only in the scenario layer; never in a scored forecast.

targets.note: Horizon 0 is the nowcast of the current quarter, reported separately for origins in months 1, 2 and 3 of the quarter.

targets.definition: 1 if at least one month in (t, t+h] is an NBER recession month in the chronology available at evaluation time
targets.note: About eight post-war recessions: low statistical power. Ceiling LIMITED_DEPLOYMENT.

actuals.primary: first publication of the target value
actuals.secondary: value in the vintage available 12 months after the reference period
actuals.rule: Both are always reported, never pooled. T3 uses the NBER chronology as of the evaluation date.

estimation.reason: Giacomini-White tests require a finite estimation window; a recursive (expanding) window is excluded.

data_depth.classification_rule: A forecast is REAL_TIME only if every input series comes from the vintage available at the origin; otherwise it is PSEUDO_REAL_TIME. Only REAL_TIME forecasts count toward C1, C2, C4 and C5; PSEUDO_REAL_TIME forecasts are reported separately.
data_depth.consequence: DFM_FREDMD is REAL_TIME only from origin 1999-08, so W1 (1990-2006) is mostly pseudo-real-time for it.

alfred_panel.fallback: DFM counts toward admission from 1999-08 only

data_depth.gate: R2 acceptance: reconstruct what was known on a date t for 2000-2026; a spot check of at least 30 (series, date) pairs must match the primary-source release of that time, within rounding.
vintage_sources: Philadelphia Fed Real-Time Data Set for Macroeconomists

licence_notes.GDPNow: Archive terms: personal and educational use only. Do not redistribute the archive; obtain permission before publishing results that embed it.

W3.use: stress report only; contaminated by researcher and LLM knowledge of the episode

forward_registry.use: the only uncontaminated window; the start is the date of the first registry commit, no backdating

baselines.note: Atkeson-Ohanian average of the last four quarters / historical mean
autoregression, order by BIC, rolling window
factors from FRED-MD/QD, number by information criterion
Sahm recession indicator converted to a probability by logistic calibration on the rolling window
Philadelphia Fed SPF median, at SPF survey deadlines only
SPF reports the probability of negative quarterly real GDP growth, not an NBER recession; descriptive only
Atlanta Fed GDPNow and NY Fed Staff Nowcast, horizon 0 only; subject to the licence notes
equal-weight combination of the scored baselines that apply and are REAL_TIME at the origin

primary_comparator_rule: EQUAL_WEIGHT, fixed before any candidate is evaluated, without a selection window. A candidate is also reported against every other scored baseline.

admission.scope: per (target, horizon) pair; a model can be ACTIVE for one pair and not for another

criteria.text: relative loss (candidate/primary comparator) <= threshold on W1 and on W2 separately; threshold per admission.threshold_rule

Giacomini-White conditional predictive ability test, rolling estimation window per estimation, HAC with h-1 lags and Harvey-Leybourne-Newbold small-sample correction, one-sided p < 0.10 on W1 and on W2
Model Confidence Set 90% against all scored baselines: membership and set size are reported; short samples make the set wide, so it does not gate

relative loss <= 1.00 in NBER recession months of W1 and W2 and the Giacomini-White test with instruments (constant, recession indicator) does not reject at 10% in favour of the comparator; inconclusive if fewer than 12 recession months
not significantly worse than the primary comparator on the secondary actuals
at least 12 resolved forward-registry forecasts for the pair, cumulative relative loss <= 1.00 and empirical interval coverage within 10 percentage points of nominal

threshold_rule.q05_equal_methods: 5th percentile of the relative loss between two statistically equivalent forecasting methods, from the NF-SIM study

noise_floor_study.design: Simulate pairs of methods with the same data-generating process and different estimation noise, calibrated on the baselines.

long_horizon.resolved_definition: A forecast is resolved when its target period has been published; it is evaluable at origin + horizon.
long_horizon.independent_outcome: A resolved forecast whose target window does not overlap another counted forecast.

stages.CANDIDATE_to_SHADOW_TEST: C1, C2, C4, C5 on REAL_TIME historical forecasts
stages.LIMITED_DEPLOYMENT_to_ACTIVE: C6 repeated over a second, non-overlapping block, no drift trigger, and long_horizon.min_independent_outcomes_for_ACTIVE met

multiplicity.registry_of_candidates: Every candidate that was evaluated is recorded, including rejected ones; the count is part of every report.
multiplicity.primary: Romano-Wolf stepdown, family-wise error rate 0.10, over all candidates evaluated per (target, horizon).
multiplicity.secondary: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR q = 0.10, reported only because candidate losses are dependent.
multiplicity.many_candidates: White Reality Check or Hansen SPA when more than 20 candidates are compared against the same comparator.

model_class_rules.data: Same real-time vintages as every other candidate; a forecast on the latest vintage compared with a baseline trained on older vintages is invalid.
model_class_rules.llm_evidence: A result counts only if it comes from (a) the forward registry, (b) a period after the model's documented knowledge cutoff, or (c) a chronologically consistent model. Any other result is labelled CONTAMINATED and excluded from C1 to C5.
model_class_rules.agent_selection: A model or hypothesis proposed by an LLM agent and selected on historical windows is CONTAMINATED for those windows.

required_variants: robust outlier handling (Lenza-Primiceri variance scaling or an outlier component in stochastic volatility)
variant with the window excluded from estimation
covid_handling.reporting: W3 is reported separately for each variant; W3 never counts toward admission.

forward_registry.cadence: monthly, after the last data release of the month
forward_registry.integrity: committed to the repository before the actual value is published; rows are append-only; a correction is a new row that references the old one

drift_triggers.coverage: interval coverage outside nominal +-15 percentage points over the trailing 24 months
drift_triggers.action: SUSPENDED and review per D-101; automatic rollback only to the previous ACTIVE version

changes_from_v1.summary: Rolling finite estimation window; Clark-West for recursive variants.
Forecasting methods are compared, not the truth of models.
Primary comparator is EQUAL_WEIGHT; the 1985-1989 selection window is removed.
Real-time depth recorded; REAL_TIME and PSEUDO_REAL_TIME separated; ALFRED panel is an R2 task.
SPF removed from scored T3 baselines; SAHM_RULE added; SPF_NEG_GDP_PROB kept as unscored.
SPF comparisons use SPF survey-deadline origins.
C6 counts resolved forecasts; long horizons capped at LIMITED_DEPLOYMENT without 8 independent outcomes.
C4 uses a Giacomini-White test with a recession instrument.
C1 threshold is min(0.97, simulated noise floor).
Romano-Wolf stepdown is primary; BH secondary.
Scored forecasts are precise distributions; imprecise probabilities only in scenarios.
Foundation models and LLMs use real-time vintages and uncontaminated evidence only.
Robust and excluded variants for 2020-03 to 2021-02.
